# Bits and Builds Studio

> Next.js web engineering, Google Maps 3-Pack rank dominance, Meta & Google Ads, and 24/7 WhatsApp booking automations for local businesses and modern brands across India and beyond.

## Overview
Bits and Builds is a digital engineering and growth studio founded by Lavi and Jass in Sri Ganganagar, Rajasthan, India. We combine sub-second web performance, local search visibility, high-ROAS performance marketing, and automated conversational workflows into one cohesive engine.

## Core Capabilities
- Web Development: Next.js 14 App Router, React, Tailwind CSS, SSR/SSG, Sub-second Core Web Vitals (LCP < 1.2s, INP < 100ms).
- Local SEO & Google Maps: Google Business Profile (GMB) optimization, 3-Pack rank dominance, local geo-citations, review schema.
- Meta & Google Ads: Server-Side Facebook Conversions API (CAPI), Google Search ads, high-ROAS creative testing.
- WhatsApp Automation: WhatsApp Cloud API, 24/7 lead capture, OPD appointment booking, automated payment links.
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO): Optimizing brand knowledge graph for Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini search engines.
- Brand Identity & UI/UX: Vector design systems in Figma, typography hierarchy, high-contrast dark/light design systems.
